'''''Galactic Gathering 2008''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] made during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted an [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]], some [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], as well as a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] encompassing two different [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and two [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]], with the words "Galactic Gathering 2008" on it.

==Behind the scenes==
The poster was given out to players who logged in to the 2008 summit. It was recently changed to become a tradeable item from a shared no trade item.
